title: LoRASpace: A Pool-Wide Shared Substrate for Static and Dynamic Multi-LoRA Composition
title_zh: LoRASpace：一个面向静态与动态多LoRA组合的池级共享基底

paragraphs.en: LoRASpace提出一种免训练的池级共享子空间方法，可在合并成本下实现高质量静态多LoRA组合，并以超6倍速度加速动态多LoRA推理。 Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) attaches small low-rank matrices to a frozen backbone, and public repositories host many LoRAs per backbone, each for a different concept or task. Combining several LoRAs in one generation forces a trade-off. Merging their weights into one update needs a single forward pass, but LoRAs trained for different concepts interfere and quality drops. Running each LoRA in its own forward pass (composite) preserves quality, but inference time grows linearly with the number of active LoRAs. We study a property of LoRA pools overlooked by prior multi-LoRA work. In real LoRA pools, the stacked low-rank factors need far fewer directions than their summed ranks. Using singular value decomposition, we find the minimal subspace that keeps 99% of the factor energy. On three diffusion pools, only 46% to 57% of the summed LoRA ranks is needed, and the subspace grows sub-linearly with pool size. A 48-LoRA sub-pool of LoRA-Hub on FLAN-T5 tasks shows comparable overlap (62%), while the diversity-curated LoRA-Retriever benchmark sits near the no-overlap baseline (96%), so pool composition rather than modality predicts where compression is large. We build on this overlap with LoRASpace, a training-free method that computes the subspace once per pool and reuses it in two inference modes, a static mode at merge cost and a dynamic mode for input-dependent routing. On the diffusion pools, static LoRASpace matches composite quality at merge cost, and dynamic LoRASpace is more than 6x faster than composite with six active LoRAs on a 17-LoRA pool, mainly because it runs one backbone pass instead of six. In an ablation, static variants at the same rank match LoRASpace, so the quality gain does not depend on the pool-wide basis. On the near-orthogonal LoRA-Retriever benchmark, compression is small and gains come from coupling with external retrieval.
paragraphs.zh: LoRASpace提出一种免训练的池级共享子空间方法，可在合并成本下实现高质量静态多LoRA组合，并以超6倍速度加速动态多LoRA推理。低秩适配（LoRA）将小型低秩矩阵附加到冻结的主干模型上，公共仓库中为每个主干模型托管了大量LoRA，每个对应不同的概念或任务。 在一次生成中组合多个LoRA会带来权衡。 将它们的权重合并为一个更新只需一次前向传播，但针对不同概念训练的LoRA会相互干扰，导致质量下降。 在各自的前向传播中运行每个LoRA（复合模式）可以保持质量，但推理时间随活跃LoRA数量线性增长。 我们研究了此前多LoRA工作所忽视的LoRA池的一个特性。 在真实的LoRA池中，堆叠的低秩因子所需的方向远少于其秩之和。 利用奇异值分解，我们找到了能保留99%因子能量的最小子空间。 在三个扩散模型池上，只需要LoRA秩之和的46%到57%，且该子空间随池规模呈亚线性增长。 FLAN-T5任务上LoRA-Hub的48个LoRA子池显示出相近的重叠度（62%），而经多样性筛选的LoRA-Retriever基准则接近无重叠基线（96%），因此决定压缩程度的是池的构成而非模态。 我们基于这种重叠构建了LoRASpace，这是一种免训练方法，为每个池计算一次子空间，并在两种推理模式中复用它：合并成本下的静态模式，以及面向输入依赖路由的动态模式。 在扩散模型池上，静态LoRASpace以合并成本达到复合模式的质量，而在17个LoRA的池上使用6个活跃LoRA时，动态LoRASpace比复合模式快6倍以上，主要因为它只运行一次主干前向传播而非六次。 在消融实验中，相同秩的静态变体与LoRASpace表现相当，因此质量提升并不依赖于池级基。 在接近正交的LoRA-Retriever基准上，压缩幅度很小，增益来自与外部检索的耦合。
